answer: Sybil herds stall at one irrigation gate. An applicant bonds 2.70 POA and draws a 7-minute drip interval on a 24-arm vine trellis cut into the west face of a mesa. Within 45 seconds they fire a 13-hertz hydraulic pulse bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed, then hang a 6.2 g tagged cluster on that arm. 160 clones would lock 432 POA and need 160 exclusive intervals. Graders replay the arm draw from the seed, match the pulse cadence to the flume log, and weigh the cluster to 0.07 g. A reused arm, off-cadence pulse, or short cluster slashes 56% and idles that trellis bank for 3 epochs.
